title: Module Context Configuration
description: Schema for context.yaml of a module - objective, users, routes, risks, notes, sensitive selectors, and PRD source

objective.description: Primary objective or goal of this module

users.description: List of user types or roles involved in this module

routes.description: List of routes or paths covered by this module

risks.description: List of identified risks for this module

notes.description: Additional notes or context for this module

sensitive_selectors.description: List of CSS selectors that target sensitive data (passwords, PII, etc.)

manually_edited.description: Indicates if this context file has been manually edited by a human

prd_source.description: Optional reference to the Product Requirements Document source
